A full read needs either the Faculty role filter applied programmatically or repeated 'Load more' clicks; not attempted this pass given time. The department's architecture.mit.edu/index.php/research-labs page (linked from the main nav) may be a better source for PI-led labs specifically and should be tried next. Several of MIT Architecture's named research groups already have their own targets.csv rows (mit-arch-ddf, mit-arch-design-intelligence, mit-arch-digital-structures, mit-arch-era, mit-arch-self-assembly-lab, mit-arch-sustainable-design-lab) handled separately.
